theme: Quiet Saturday, loud countdown to Croatia.
greeting: Nothing on the calendar today but the FloridaRAMA searchlight hunt whenever the mood strikes, Dan, and the girls are with you and Mike in St. Pete. The pressure is all in the Croatia countdown: several bookings are past due with the Sept 8 flight closing in.

needsAttention.title: Croatia bookings still open before Sept 8
needsAttention.detail: Three p1 travel items are past due in Todoist: the Sept 19 Cavtat night after the charter, the Sept 20-22 St Pete landing gap, and confirming checked bags are on the Eurowings Discover ticket. All need settling before you fly Sept 8 and lose boat connectivity.

needsAttention.title: Sunday board review with Mike
needsAttention.detail: Mike's weekly 15-minute triage is at 9 AM. A glance at the 'Dan & Mike Stuff' board tonight means you arrive with the inbox already sorted.

flagged.title: Nautilus charter balance due
flagged.detail: QuickBooks shows invoice 2170 for Nautilus Sailing with $6,475 still outstanding.

flagged.title: Caregiver applicants waiting
flagged.detail: Several care.com applicants applied to your posting and are nudging for a reply.

inbox.noise: Mostly promotions today, Chairish, Nextdoor, West Marine, and Tom's Studio.
inbox.clear: Nothing else needs a reply tonight.

recipe.title: Canal House year-round caprese salad
recipe.why: Peak-season tomatoes and basil are at their sweetest right now, so a caprese needs almost nothing done to it.

tasks.title: Book the Cavtat hotel for the Sept 19 night
Book St Pete lodging for the Sept 20-22 gap
Confirm checked bags on the Croatia ticket

acts.line: Nothing scheduled, so the morning is yours until you decide to head out.
FloridaRAMA's searchlight hunt stays open until 8, good for whenever the light turns.
An open night at the Kenwood place, the kind that rewards a slow dinner.
